name: Grabient Component

description.zh: 看具体黄粉渐变、三色值、RGB曲线和参数。 Grabient提供浏览器渐变生成与调色板目录，可查看色值、曲线和参数，并设有CSS、SVG、PNG等输出入口。当前网页取用有0美元直接价格证据，渐变输出与平台源码许可分开核对；制作程序当前受FSL竞争用途限制。
description.en: Grabient combines a browser gradient editor with a searchable palette gallery. A concrete editor renders a gradient with color values, curves and parameter controls. The current web offer states zero USD; gradient output permissions and the software repository’s FSL restrictions are assessed separately.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Grabient (https://grabient.com/).
Technology stack: css, svg.
Component specification: 看具体黄粉渐变、三色值、RGB曲线和参数。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页看三张完整渐变，再下滚比较新增预设；下方三张完整，上行三张顶部受固定栏遮挡，仅代表可见子集。具体黄粉渐变页已渲染三色结果，右侧有RGB曲线和参数控件，本次未改参数、复制或下载。网页取用的0美元来自原JSON-LD；输出许可与平台FSL源码限制分别核对，不把免费输出等同无限制使用程序。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
